description.from:
**Milestone:** M2, operators finished

**Goal.** As a person or an admin, I can prove a channel works and see what was sent. Console buttons come with PPY-17cf09 and PPY-d7443d; this is the service side and the `caducus` CLI.

**Build.**
- API routes `POST /v1/test`, `GET /v1/history` (IAM, see kanbus-ff4727; for M2 the CLI uses the operator's AWS session). `caducus notify test <channel>`, `caducus notify history [--person|--site|--kind]`.
- A test is a real send through the channel and logged with kind `caducus.test`, sent only to the caller's own destination.
- A person sees their own history. Admins see their site's, addresses masked unless they are the owner or admin of that Account, as in the Papyrus newsletter panel.

**Acceptance.**
Behave features; live test via the mailbox simulator.

**Depends on:** kanbus-53a88d, kanbus-cfe4b9

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Test and history
  Scenario: Send a test
    When I press send a test for my email channel
    Then one test message goes only to my own address
    And it appears in my history with its result

  Scenario: An admin reads history
    Given an admin of a site
    When they read the site's delivery history
    Then they see kind, channel, result and time for each delivery
```
description.to:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** M2, operators finished

**Goal.** As a person or an admin, I can prove a channel works and see what was sent. Library calls plus the `caducus notify` CLI for operators; console buttons come with PPY-17cf09 and PPY-d7443d. There's no history across sites: each host holds its own.

**Build.**
- `testsend.py`, `history.py` in the package. `caducus notify test`, `caducus notify history [--person|--kind]`, with `--table` or environment, on the operator's AWS session.
- A test is a real send logged as kind `caducus.test`, only to the caller's own destination. A person sees their own history. Admins see their site's, masked unless they are its owner or admin.

**Acceptance.**
Behave features; live through the simulator once hosted.

**Depends on:** kanbus-53a88d, kanbus-cfe4b9
**Related:** PPY-3e260c, PPY-17cf09, PPY-d7443d

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Test and history
  Scenario: Send a test
    When I press send a test for my email channel
    Then one test message goes only to my own address
    And it appears in my history with its result

  Scenario: An admin reads history
    Given an admin of a site
    When they read the site's delivery history
    Then they see kind, channel, result and time for each delivery
```
